subject: cd
question: Define annotated parse tree with example.
title: Parse Tree With Numbers
hook: A parse tree is just a tree. Give every node a number and it computes.
answer: Annotated (decorated) parse tree = parse tree whose nodes carry attribute values computed by semantic rules
Example rule: E → E1 + T { E.val = E1.val + T.val }, F → digit { F.val = digit.lexval }
Input 2 + 3: leaves F.val = 2 and 3, T.val = 2 / 3, E1.val = 2, root E.val = 5
Synthesized attributes are evaluated bottom-up (child to parent)
